summary.text: Richard Rettig is the Democratic candidate for the Ohio House of Representatives, District 75, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An educator who said in a Ballotpedia survey that he has worked in education for 33 years, he lists funding public schools among his main priorities.

paragraphs.text: Richard Rettig earned a high school diploma from Napoleon High School and bachelor's and graduate degrees from Bowling Green State University in 1993 and 1999.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as educator.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Rettig, who goes by Rick, said he has spent 33 years in education, teaching English and Business and serving as a school counselor for 24 years, including time as department chair.
He also said he has coached golf, baseball, and speech and debate.

Rettig's key messages in the survey included full, permanent implementation of the Fair School Funding Plan, ending Ohio's private school voucher program, securing teacher retirement with cost-of-living adjustments, and increasing funding for school mental health resources.

He also listed supporting universal pre-K, expanding loan availability for trade schools and apprenticeships, and requiring environmental and community impact studies before new data centers are approved.
